R8416.summary: The one cipher passage in Thomas Spinelly's clear despatch from the Low Countries: the Audiencier and Luigi Marliano (misser Loys de Merlien) report that the King (Charles) will make his entry into Brussels at the end of the week and that the Emperor Maximilian will go to Cambrai about the 15th of the month. Letters and Papers II 2862 had summarised only the Cambrai sentence.

system: Monoalphabetic substitution with invented signs (Greek and Latin letters for other values), word division kept, plus word signs for of, this, that, the Emperor and probably the King.
